name: Holiday Honey-Maple Glazed Soft Cooked Carrots & Roasted Butternut Squash
whyItWorks: The safest vegetable sides on the holiday table: peeled carrots and peeled butternut squash cooked until fork-mashable provide 100% gut-soothing soluble fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Roast or simmer peeled carrots and peeled cubed butternut squash with olive oil/ghee and maple syrup or honey until completely soft.
watchOuts: Skip Brussels sprouts, raw kale/cranberry salads, and whole corn at the holiday table
